entities.summary: Bengt Bengtsson Oxenstierna af Eka och Lindö, Baron of Eka and Lindö (1591–1643), in non-contemporary sources sometimes referred to as Resare-Bengt, was a Swedish diplomat and noble, Swedish Privy Councillor, and Governor-General of Ingria and Livonia. He is mainly known for his extensive travels, as he was one of the few Swedish contemporaries who travelled to Persia, Palestine and Egypt.
